Organizations get their own page in Settings where you can manage who's in them, recordings get one title no matter which device names them, and Settings is quieter.

**Settings › Organizations** (#588)

The page appears once you're signed in. It replaces the small Organizations field at the bottom of Account.

- Open an organization to see its members. Owners and admins can switch someone between Member and Admin right in the list, remove them, or (owners only) transfer ownership, which makes you an admin.
- Invite several people at once by pasting their addresses, as Member or Admin. Typos, people already in the organization and people already invited are flagged before you send.
- Invitations you've sent are listed with how long they have left (48 hours). Revoke one, or renew one that expired.
- Invitations sent to you show at the top of the page with Join and Decline, as a badge on Organizations in the Settings sidebar, and once as a notice in the main window.
- Rename an organization, leave one (the last owner has to transfer it first), or delete one you own.
- If you leave the organization new recordings were set to save into, they save to Personal instead.

**One title per recording, on every device** (#585)

- Desktop, iPhone and Android now title and suggest a folder for a recording with the same instructions, in the app's language, and only once. A recording no longer shows a different title on the Mac than on the phone, or two titles at once.
- Renaming a recording clears any pending title suggestion.

**Settings say less** (#586)

- Explanations moved behind a small (i) next to each setting. Warnings you need to act on still show.
- The MCP page is a single card with copy buttons.
- On macOS, View Logs and Clear Cache live in the Diagnostics menu in the menu bar instead of Settings.

**Fixes**

- Lines in a meeting's transcript can be highlighted and copied again; clicking a line still jumps the audio there (#583).
- A long recording name in the title bar ends in "…" instead of sliding under the Report / Replay tabs (#584).
